targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM orders WHERE created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid' AND created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
SELECT coalesce(sum(amount), 0) / 100.0 AS value FROM payments WHERE status = 'succeeded' AND paid_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS time, count(*) AS value FROM orders WHERE created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('day', paid_at) AS time, sum(amount) / 100.0 AS value FROM payments WHERE status = 'succeeded' AND paid_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT category, count(*) AS products, count(*) FILTER (WHERE active) AS active_products FROM products GROUP BY category ORDER BY products DESC
